title: PaisaPulse Ledger
description: A personal finance Android app that detects banking transactions from SMS, categorizes expenses, tracks monthly budgets, visualizes spending, supports manual entries and CSV export, and protects access with a biometric lock. Built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, with local persistence and background processing. Its categorization backend has been migrated from FastAPI to Java Spring Boot.

title: API Gateway – GateKeeper
description: Designed a custom API Gateway with Spring Boot rather than relying on Spring Cloud Gateway. Includes an API Management Service for configuration, centralized dynamic routing through a Smart Gateway Service, and secure access with Spring Security and JWT. Redis supports rate limiting, while Apache Kafka enables asynchronous analytics events. MySQL stores API management data and MongoDB stores analytics data.

title: FinCart – Personal Finance REST API
description: Built REST APIs for authentication and expense management with CRUD operations, pagination, sorting and category-based filtering. Implemented JWT authentication with Spring Security, BCrypt password hashing, resource-ownership checks, request validation and centralized exception handling. Uses Spring Data JPA/Hibernate with PostgreSQL and Docker Compose for reproducible local development.
